faq.question: How do I convert an HTML file to PDF?
faq.answer: Upload your .html file and the converter lays the document out page by page, then gives you a PDF to download.

faq.question: Will my CSS styling be preserved?
faq.answer: Partly. Headings, paragraphs, lists, tables, fonts, sizes, colors and simple spacing are applied. Advanced layout such as flexbox, grid and floats is not supported, so multi-column pages can end up stacked instead of side by side.

faq.question: Is JavaScript executed?
faq.answer: No. Only the HTML that is already in the file is rendered. Content that a script injects after the page loads will not appear in the PDF.

faq.question: Are images included in the PDF?
faq.answer: Only images embedded in the file as data URIs. Nothing is fetched from the network, so an image referenced by URL is replaced by a placeholder in the output.

faq.question: Is the text still selectable in the output?
faq.answer: Yes. The PDF carries a real text layer rather than a screenshot of the page, so you can select, search and copy text.

faq.question: How large a file can I upload?
faq.answer: Up to 500 KB of HTML, rendering up to 500 pages within 20 seconds. Documents beyond those limits are refused with a clear message instead of a partial PDF.

faq.question: Which file encodings work?
faq.answer: UTF-8, with or without a byte-order mark, and UTF-16 when it carries a BOM. If a file is not UTF-8 you will be told, rather than receiving a PDF of garbled characters.

faq.question: What if the conversion fails?
faq.answer: You get the reason: an unreadable encoding, a document over one of the limits, a render that ran out of time, or a page that would have come out blank. Files are processed securely and deleted after conversion.

about_formats.title: What is HTML?
about_formats.text: HTML is the markup language behind web pages. It describes content and structure, while styling and behavior can depend on CSS files, scripts and network resources that are not part of the file.

about_formats.title: What is PDF?
about_formats.text: PDF is a portable document format ideal for printing, sharing, and archiving documents with consistent layout everywhere.

about_formats.title: How faithful is the conversion?
about_formats.text: This converter uses a real HTML layout engine, so text, headings, lists, tables and basic CSS come through with a selectable text layer. It does not run JavaScript, does not fetch anything over the network, and does not implement flexbox, grid or float layout.

about_formats.title: What is PDF format?
about_formats.text: PDF is a popular file format chosen for its broad compatibility and consistent rendering on every platform.
